name: Main Gate
hint: I open every morning and close every night; everyone passes me, yet no one stays. Find the place where the campus begins.

name: Basketball Court
hint: Ten feet up, a ring with no finger; bounce, jump, and shoot. Stand where the hoops hang.

name: Library
hint: Whispers only, shelves of paper minds. Find the quiet house of books.

name: Old Academic Block Entrance
hint: Where lectures first began on campus: find the doorway of the old academic block.

name: Old Library
hint: Behind the old library, where stories are older than the students reading them.

name: Cafeteria
hint: Steam rises, trays clatter and tea is always brewing. Stand beside the cafeteria.

name: Hostel Entrance
hint: I am home for many but a house for none; lights out at eleven. Find the hostel door.

name: Auditorium
hint: Seats in rows, a stage in front, applause behind the doors. Stand near the auditorium.

name: Football Ground
hint: Grass, two goals and a whistle. Find the widest green on campus.

name: Campus Entrance Garden
hint: Close to the main entrance, where flowers greet everyone who arrives.
